<function name="SetWidth" parent="DListView_Column" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets the width of the panel.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="width" type="number">The number value which will determine panel width.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>
Creates a DListView and populates it with two columns and two items, only one of which can be selected at a time.

The first column width is 15.
The second column width is 350.
	</description>
	<code>
local Frame = vgui.Create( "DFrame" )
Frame:SetSize( 500, 500 )
Frame:Center()
Frame:MakePopup()

local SimpleList = vgui.Create( "DListView", Frame )
SimpleList:Dock( FILL )
SimpleList:SetMultiSelect( false )

SimpleList:AddColumn( "Column 1" ):SetWidth(15)
SimpleList:AddColumn( "Column 2" ):SetWidth(350)

SimpleList:AddLine( "First", "Column" )
SimpleList:AddLine( "Second", "Column" )
	</code>
	<output><image src="DListView_Column_SetWidth.png"/></output>

</example>
